text:
Predicates:
DigitalMedia(x) ::: x is digital media.
Analog(x) ::: x is analog.
PrintedText(x) ::: x is printed text.
StreamingService(x) ::: x is a streaming service.
HardcoverBook(x) ::: x is a hardcover book.
Object1984(x) ::: x is the object 1984.
Publish(x) ::: x is published.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
Year1984(y) ::: y is the year 1984.
Premises:
¬∃x (DigitalMedia(x) ∧ Analog(x)) ::: No digital media are analog.
∀x (PrintedText(x) → Analog(x)) ::: Every printed text is analog.
∀x (StreamingService(x) → DigitalMedia(x)) ::: All streaming services are digital.
∀x (HardcoverBook(x) → PrintedText(x)) ::: If an object is a hardcover book then it is printed text.
∀x (Object1984(x) → StreamingService(x)) → Object1984(x) → HardcoverBook(x) ::: If 1984 is a streaming service, then 1984 is a hardcover book.
Publish(1984, y) ∧ Year(y) ∧ y = 1984 ::: 1984 is published in 1984.
Conclusion:
Object1984(1984) → PrintedText(1984)
